svg.title: 1 tower power box wiring
svg.desc: 1 tower power box: mains, S-100-5, one 74AHCT125 (gate 1 joined to the 4 JST-SM strands), top-feed XT60. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: 1 tower power box — in T3 and T5 of each statue, 4 to build
Mains in. One 74AHCT125, 1 gate used: gate 1 → its own tower's 4 JST-SM (one per face). One XT60 out for the top feed.
Nothing for a tip tower. (T4's power box is this same circuit inside the master/slave box.)
the data cable from the master/slave box
one wire per face from this point
XT60 out · top feed, own tower
at the top → 4 × XT60 to the strand tops
What goes into one 1 tower power box
C14 inlet with switch and fuse
74AHCT125 in a DIP socket (1 gate used)
JST-SM out: faces 1–4, all from gate 1
no second data in, no second XT60, no tip-tower data out
All flags with the same label are the same wire. The data inputs' 5V pins stay
unconnected so two supplies never join on +5 V. 100 Ω resistors optional.
Unused gates: input to GND, output open. No electronics anywhere in a tower:
the 4 faces are joined on the perfboard, after the 100 Ω.
T4's power box: this same circuit inside the master/slave box, plus the
perfboard feed for the ESP32 / transceivers.
